openwrt_wiki.5ghz_phy: The chip Ubiquiti U-AME-G1-BR4A seems to be a custom labeled QCA9882-BR4A (2x2:2 MIMO). It is detected as QCA988X/hw2.0 and supported by the ath10k driver.
openwrt_wiki.serial_console: The device has two pinheaders with serial ports. Both ports operate at 3.3V level, 115200 Baud, 8N1 and have the pinout +3,3V - RX - TX - GND. The port to the left (shown red) gives access to U-Boot and OpenWrt's console. The purpose of the other port (shown blue) is not identified yet. Using the default/factory U-Boot environment there are no outputs from the kernel during booting. Instead, one has to send a newline at 9600 Baud (to activate the console) and then login at 115200 Baud again. To overcome this, one can alter the bootargs environment variable in U-Boot.
openwrt_wiki.serial_port2_ausgabe: CLI>build_version=0x11, rom_version=0x41020000, ram_version=0x11, stack_size=6348 / reset reason=0x0 / Image startup of Normal mode
openwrt_wiki.leds: The UniFi AP AC has two LEDs (ubnt:white:dome, ubnt:blue:dome)
openwrt_wiki.reset_verhalten: Pushing and holding down the reset button (either on the device itself or on the PoE injector) while powering up: after about 5 seconds the blue LED will light up and U-Boot erases the cfg-partition; keeping the button pushed for additional 8 seconds replaces the U-Boot environment and starts a TFTP server on 192.168.1.20 (LEDs blue, white, pause).
openwrt_wiki.tftp_recovery: Keep the reset button pressed till the LED ring is blinking white/blue/off (ca. 15 sec.). The UAP is now a TFTP server at 192.168.1.20. It will not respond to pings or serve DHCP.
openwrt_wiki.installation_kurz: Kein factory-Image; Installation per SSH (ubnt/ubnt) und dd/mtd auf kernel0/kernel1 oder per serieller Konsole + U-Boot + TFTP. Firmware 6.7.35 laut Wiki auf AC Lite nicht funktionierend, Downgrade auf 6.5.28 per TFTP-Recovery.

forum_73027.hardware_aussage: I have a couple of these UniFi AC Lite APs, older versions from 2016-2017 (before they supported PoE 802.3af, in case various hardware revisions behave differently).

werkstatt.erstinstallation_ohne_factory: Gruppe D Ubiquiti UniFi (12 Images, u. a. UniFi AC Lite). Wege: SSH ubnt/ubnt + fwupdate.real (auf neueren Ständen gepatcht nötig) oder TFTP-Recovery: Reset-Taste beim Einschalten halten, bis der LED-Ring blau/weiß blinkt (~15 s). Der zweite Weg ist der verlässlichere.

Offener Labortest: 2016.2-Knoten UniFi AC Lite mit Alt-Konfiguration springen lassen.
